svg.title: Literal 39-gate controlled Hamiltonian kernel
svg.desc: Read four panels top to bottom, with time running left to right in each panel. The three physical wires remain q[0] phase control, q[1] data zero, and q[2] data one. All 39 instructions from the recorded kernel are shown individually. Dots and plus circles show directed CX gates; each rotation retains its recorded angle using the legend. There is no opaque oracle box. This is the coherent kernel, with no resets or readouts. The full measured exports are linked by the companion page.
